thread:
Nadia: Observed a slow growth in KV residency across 3 canaries starting ~06:40 UTC; two OOMs at 06:47. Dash: https://metrics.internal/redwood/kv/residency_multi Heap dump uploaded: s3://redwood-infer/dumps/3287654321-multi-heap.tar.gz
Owen: Oncall. Pausing canaries and scaling down prefetch concurrency globally to 30%. Who wants to own triage & short-term guards?
Priya: I'll take triage. Quick `pprof --alloc_space` shows a cluster of retained spans in the 128k bucket with top frames in prefetch cancellation + alloc_map.reserveFast. Hypothesis: fast-path reserve sometimes skips freelist release on cancel.
Maya: Ops will add a temporary runtime cap KV_MAX_RESIDENCY=95MB to canaries and flip soft-eviction on. Scheduling a rolling restart at 23:30 UTC. Creating a ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-1623 "multi-canary residency & emergency guard" https://jira.internal/INF-1623 Assigned to Maya, due 2026-04-08.
ci-bot: Canary rollback executed -> stable rev 804 restored. Health checks green. Monitoring window 45m. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Plan: (1) correlated slab-scan + vmstat capture during repro (2) ms-resolution alloc sampling (3) small race fuzz to repro cancel vs reserve. ETA: 48h for initial write-up. Assigning to Priya.
Nadia: Also add a short-term orchestration guard: if any pool crosses 85% of KV_MAX_RESIDENCY for 5m, auto-divert canary traffic to stable. Ops, can you add that?
Maya: Will implement circuit in ingress and add runbook steps. Example flip: `kubectl set env deploy/kv-canary KV_MAX_RESIDENCY=95MB -n canary` and circuit: `POST /ingress/circuit {"pool":"all-canaries","threshold":0.85}`. Ops will run nightly slab-scan for 3 nights and post digests to this thread.
Owen: I'll hold interim oncall for monitoring and correlate with the monthly memory-retro notes to see recurring patterns. Marking INF-1623 on my board.
Priya: Early grep: recent PR#934 touched reserveFast micro-optimizations and PR#941 touched prefetch cancellation. I'll diff both and attach suspected hunks to the profiling report.
Nadia: Good. If it's a regression we prefer a small safe rollback or targeted patch to ensure release on cancel. Longer-term: add KV refcount telemetry and slab freelist coalescing.
Maya: Ops will also add a temporary cluster-wide quota per-pool `KV_POOL_QUOTA=1.2GB` for canaries to limit blast radius while we triage. Adding to INF-1623 runbook.
Priya: Uploading first profiler bundle: s3://redwood-infer/profiles/3287654400-pri-prof.tar.gz. Will post slab-scan digest in 12h and a repro if found.
Owen: Summary action items: - Priya: profiling + slab-scan + repro (48h) - Maya/Ops: apply KV_MAX_RESIDENCY guard + ingress circuit + pool quota (today) - Owen: monitoring + cross-incident correlation (ongoing) - Nadia: draft postmortem stub and remediation runway (72h).
Priya: If repro is narrow, I'll propose an urgent fix PR with unit test and bench; otherwise we'll plan a small refactor of reservation lifecycle.
Maya: Nightly restart scheduled at 23:30 UTC. ops-bot will post progress.
ops-bot: Rolling restarts started for canary nodes. Progress: 1/6 complete.
Nadia: Let's reconvene in 48h at 11:00 to review Priya's findings and decide whether to ship a patch or widen mitigations. Reopen thread if any pool regresses before then. :eyes:
